h: In the heart of the Cynon Valley
p: Market Street is right in the centre of Aberdare, a short walk from Victoria Square, where the statue of the choir conductor Caradog stands. It's a compact town, so you can easily walk between the shops, the market and the station, which has regular trains down the valley to Cardiff.

For a breather, Aberdare Park is one of the nicest Victorian parks in the valleys, with a boating lake and bandstand, and Dare Valley Country Park on the edge of town has waterfalls, walks and big views of the hills. The Coliseum in Trecynon puts on shows and films too.
Bonanza is an 18+ venue, so it's not one for the kids. Bring ID if you look on the young side.
